title: NHL Jersey Quiz: Hard Mode
headline: Can You Name The NHL Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Jersey?
description: A hard NHL jersey quiz: eight tiny squares cut from current NHL home sweaters, no numbers, no crests, no shoulder patches. Just a sleeve stripe or a hem. Guess the team, reveal the answer, keep score.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NHL home sweater, about one fiftieth of the whole picture. No numbers, no crests, no shoulder patches. What is left is the stuff fans stop noticing: the stripes on a sleeve, the bands at the hem.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.hint: Hard mode. No numbers, no crests.
items.piece: Gold, black and white stripes on the sleeve of the black home sweater.
items.fact: Boston's first colors were brown and yellow, taken from owner Charles Adams' First National Stores grocery chain. Black and gold came later.

items.piece: The blue band, edged in white, crossing the sleeve of the red home sweater.
items.fact: The CH on the crest stands for Club de hockey Canadien, the team's official name, not Habitants.

items.piece: Yellow and white stripes on the sleeve of the red home sweater.
items.fact: The Flames started in Atlanta in 1972 and moved to Calgary in 1980.

items.piece: Yellow, navy and white stripes on the sleeve of the blue home sweater.
items.fact: The team is named after the song "St. Louis Blues," written by W.C. Handy in 1914.

items.piece: The orange band and white lower sleeve of the blue home sweater.
items.fact: The Islanders won four Stanley Cups in a row, from 1980 to 1983.

items.piece: Black and white stripes on the sleeve of the red home sweater.
items.fact: The Devils wore red and green until 1992, then switched the green to black.

items.piece: White and black stripes on the sleeve of the green home sweater.
items.fact: The franchise began as the Minnesota North Stars in 1967 and moved to Dallas in 1993.

items.piece: Gold and white stripes on the black hem of the orange home sweater.
items.fact: Anaheim made orange its main color in its 2024 rebrand, which also brought back the duck mask logo.
